phase: D1 Engineering Hardening Gate & Claim Hygiene Correction
title: Local Offline End-to-End System Skeleton Hardening and Claim Hygiene

claim_hygiene.boundary_statement: Research validation and operational prototype validation are separate. The frozen research artifacts establish only the claims documented by their respective research protocols. D1 demonstrates that a local ForecastEngine/ForecastBundle/runtime pipeline can execute offline and pass engineering integrity tests. D1 does not establish real-world forecasting or EMS performance.
claim_hygiene.demo_metrics_disclaimer: These metrics validate implementation/runtime behavior on the synthetic smoke-test scenario; they do not constitute empirical validation of POLARIS EMS performance under real station conditions.
claim_hygiene.research_transfer_disclaimer: Operational H1-H24 forecasting performance has not been established by D1. The D1 forecaster does not inherit scientific research validation.

physical_accounting.bus_bar_power_balance: P_solar_used + P_wind_used + P_dis + P_diesel == P_served + P_chg
physical_accounting.unmet_load_definition: Demand deficit (P_demand - P_served), not an energy source.

battery_model.discrete_transition_equation: E[t+1] = E[t] + (eta_chg * P_chg - P_dis / eta_dis) * dt

sample_run_metrics.disclaimer: Synthetic scenario only — not operational performance validation.
